sections.name: summary
sections.value: One coder implements pij-fleet#55 as written in impl-guide.dd.json tk-0001: red tests first, then the shared helper and coded refusals, the notice, the scripts, mutation receipts, docs, gates and the PR. Context: adopt's refusal is crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs ~818, the not-registered refusal ~1264, revive's guard crates/daemon/src/http/revive.rs ~147, script tests crates/harnesses/tests/claude_heal_scripts.rs.

value.title: Red tests on main bb9f0b1 for AC1-AC6 and AC8(d)
Daemon: shared live-copy helper, coded adopt refusal, stray-pane check, once-per-pair notice with spine audit
Scripts: SessionStart hook, UserPromptSubmit hook, status line

tk-0001.assertion: Each new test fails on bb9f0b1 for the right reason (quoted in the receipt), and none touches the live tmux server, the production daemon or the real ~/.claude

tk-0002.assertion: vd-0001 is green: coded adopt refusal with details, stray-pane refusal text, unchanged not-registered text for a pane with no record or a mismatched process start, one notice per pair across a simulated restart, and revive's existing tests still green through the shared helper

tk-0003.assertion: vd-0002 is green: each hook prints valid hook JSON with systemMessage and additionalContext only on the coded refusal, exits 0 on every path, and the registered-pane FYI claim output is unchanged; the status line shows the red double segment; a test pins the scripts' literal to the Rust constant

tk-0004.assertion: Each AC8(b) mutation turns its named test red, is restored, and the receipts are recorded in the execution log and the PR

tk-0005.assertion: docs/how/double-seat.md and the pij-rs-api.md entry exist and match the code

tk-0006.assertion: vd-0003 and vd-0004 pass; the PR is open on pij-fleet with the plan's AC evidence; GitHub CI is green on the exact head; git ls-remote origin 'refs/notes/*' is empty; any stage not run is named NOT RUN with its reason
